mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT ( CONTENT_NO, TMDB_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, OVERVIEW, POSTER_PATH, BACKDROP_PATH, RELEASE_DATE, GENRE_TEXT, RUNTIME, EPISODE_COUNT, DIRECTOR, CAST_NAMES, AGE_RATING, TMDB_SCORE, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{tmdbId}, #{contentType}, #{title}, #{originalTitle}, #{overview}, #{posterPath}, #{backdropPath}, #{releaseDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{genreText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{runtime,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{episodeCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{director,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{castNames,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ageRating,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmdbScore,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TMDB_ID AS "tmdbId", CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType", TITLE AS "title" FROM CONTENT
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET GENRE_TEXT = #{genreText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RUNTIME = #{runtime,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DIRECTOR = #{director,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST_NAMES = #{castNames,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AGE_RATING = #{ageRating,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TMDB_ID = #{tmdbId} AND CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}
mapper.select: SELECT PLATFORM_NO FROM OTT_PLATFORM WHERE PLATFORM_NAME = #{platformName} AND IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'

SELECT PLATFORM_NO AS "platformNo", PLATFORM_NAME AS "platformName", LOGO_IMAGE AS "logoImage", SITE_URL AS "siteUrl", IS_ACTIVE AS "isActive" FROM OTT_PLATFORM WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY PLATFORM_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_PLATFORM ( CONTENT_PLATFORM_NO, CONTENT_NO, PLATFORM_NO, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONTENT_PLATFORM_NO.NEXTVAL, #{contentNo}, #{platformNo}, SYSDATE )
